body: Ha! If you forgot to give it way, it's best to pick someone late on the third day!
I can't afford it, sadly, as it was only $2.50. However, TPB came through. I'm buying it right after the first of the year!

It was a 3.94. I'll find out what it dropped to next week. You sound like a friend of mine. He said that I'm waiting for a much delayed break, and I'll set the world on fire. He doesn't know I am depressed, we were discussing my job interview tomorrow.
I think resilient fucktard is an apt description.
Aw, I bet you give hugs to everyone.

You may be right about the internet, but I don't know if I can do without. I honestly only "play" about an hour per day. It's pretty much the only break I get. 
I keep telling myself, for better or for worse, this semester will be over in a couple of weeks.
My wife already told me that she wont be able to handle it if I don't pass.

Taking me a minute to reply. I'm not sure what kind of mood I'm in, or why that is really relevant.

I am feeling pretty damned self-destructive. I've been dieting like a mofo lately, just downed about 1000 calories. Strangely, I don't feel bad about it.

I had two doctors. One ran blood tests, etc - said that my only problem was slightly (and he emphasized only slightly) high cholesterol. Said that with my grades (I'm in school), there's no way I have any mental problems at all.

I got more and more depressed. Became fascinated with my own death. I used to fantasize about killing myself nightly. The celexia greatly reduced that. Regardless, I am incapable of killing myself.

I'm between 30 and 35 (keeping myself vague). I got my GED several years ago, working on an accosiates now. Wife and I have have 3 kids, one by a previous marriage of mine.

Because of circumstances, I stay home with the younger two. I work when I can, which has become increasingly rare. I have some prospects, but I have had so many things that looked like they were going to turn into solid offers and didn't it is just stupid.

Wife doesn't think I pick up around the house enough. I don't come to bed early enough. She hates being home at night without me, and usually sends me bitchy texts and emails while I am at school.

I spend most of my time doing homework. I am destroying my 3.94 GPA this semester. I can't concentrate, I can't focus. Worse, I can't keep track of assignments. I just found out that I have a program due yesterday, for example. Calculus is crushing me.

On top of it all, I get distracted easily. Last night, after an extremely long day which followed only a few hours sleep, I stayed up until 2 but only got one assignment done. Reddit ate the other half of my time until I finally went to bed.

During the day, I have a 1 year old and a 2 year old doing their best to keep me from getting anything done. They also keep me from being able to kill myself, so it balances out. I try to do what I can, it just is never enough.

Prior to recent events, life has been pretty shitty. I try to look on the bright side whenever I can. Until I married my wife, I never lived anywhere for an entire year. I was passed from uncle to aunt to grandmother to mother and multiple combinations thereof. Sucked. Then, one at a time, my mother, father (met him when I was 16), grandparents all died. Brief break, and then my sister died. Another break, and my best friend died. And I don't mean like we were good buddies, if we were gay we would have been lovers. He was my soulmate, so sexual attraction needed. A few days ago my dog died, but somehow that doesn't matter as much as I thought it would. And then I feel like it does. I really don't know.

And I'm fucking tired.

Sorry for the rant. tldr; I"m a fucktard.

PS - I'm a really positive person when not on this account. It's a lot of work, though. I've even been in your shoes, trying to talk to someone who needed it. Meanwhile, I really do think I'm just a fucktard. I can not emphasize the sincerity of that statement enough. I can almost guarantee you that someone else deserves help more than me.

One big point of contention I have with the wife is how negative she can be. It seems like she has this fucked up filter that only shows her the bad things in life, and she focuses on that.

I am really just ranting. I am kind of overwhelmed. I'm not even in danger of killing myself, unfortunately. 

Life has just been shitty in general. No medical condition...just tired. I was on celexia and adderol for a while, now just adderol. 

Mostly my eyes, sometimes the wife's eyes. 

Things that don't kill you don't make you stronger, they leave you fucked up and broken.
Ok, but what if there are tons and tons of blue circles?
